# Corporate DNA Consulting

> Global leadership advisory and executive coaching for CEOs, CHROs and executive teams — aligning leadership, accelerating decisions and building the talent required to deliver transformation. Home of the proprietary 5H® methodology and the DNA 360 Profiler. Work is delivered across 36 countries by a faculty of 75 senior practitioners, and roughly 90% of engagements are sponsored at Chairman / CXO level.

## What Corporate DNA solves
- CEO & executive performance — support for new and established CEOs and C-suite leaders through transitions, the first 100 days and sustained top-team pressure.
- Executive-team alignment — aligning senior teams behind strategy so decisions move faster.
- Leadership succession & talent — building credible successors and the enterprise leadership pipeline.
- Enterprise transformation & culture — closing the gap when transformation outpaces leadership capability.

## The 5H® Framework
The 5H® Framework is Corporate DNA's proprietary, neuroscience-led leadership methodology built on five lenses — Head (thinking), Heart (relating), Hunch (sensing), Hands (doing) and Habits (applying). Head, Heart and Hunch form the Inner Game; Hands and Habits form the Outer Game. It develops the "whole leader" rather than isolated skills, so new behaviours hold under real enterprise pressure, and is paired with the DNA 360 Profiler, which turns diagnosis into a measurable development plan.

## Facts
- Experience: ~18 years advising senior leaders.
- Global reach: delivery across 36 countries; a 75-strong faculty of senior practitioners.
- Sponsorship: ~90% of work sponsored at Chairman / CXO level.
- Academic partnerships: Harvard Business Impact and Imperial College London.
- Selected clients: Aramco, Microsoft, Visa, Shell, Coca-Cola, HSBC, Heineken, GSK, Unilever, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Disney, Pfizer.
- Offices: London (UK), Miami (US), Singapore, Dubai (UAE), Riyadh (Saudi Arabia).
